legend-florida-a1a-scenic-and-historic-c.story: National Scenic Byway. Atlantic beaches, historic coast, dunes. A one-way ride of 111 km, Ponte Vedra Beach to Ormond Beach - roughly 2 h 01 in the saddle. The stops in between: Saint Augustine and Flagler Beach. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.

scenicChapters.title: Florida A1A Scenic and Historic Coastal Byway
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 22 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.
